6C.alternative_accuracy: unlinked mirror cycles or Disputed conflicts

bundles.track: Core Spine + Claim Registry + burn_ledger + A/A Null Calibration
bundles.primary_endpoint: Engineering and A/A calibration gates, including nominal false rejection at alpha=0.05
bundles.named_comparator: Identical arms of the same retrieval, storage, and ledger harness on each host
bundles.sampling_unit: Paired resampled split within host and harness
bundles.retirement_trigger: Withhold the spine gate if integrity, isolation, or A/A calibration fails.

bundles.track: HNSW Pre-Filter Pushdown + Lazy EK5 Reason Canonicalizer
bundles.primary_endpoint: p95 <35 ms at 90% retraction with recall within 0.01 of exact fallback, query plans and p99/timeouts recorded, plus zero canonicalizer export differences
bundles.named_comparator: Exact fallback and existing EK5 reasons across Qdrant bitmap filtering, OpenSearch 3.9, and pgvector 0.8.7 iterative scan vs pre-filter
bundles.sampling_unit: 10,000 paired requests per engine/cell and property-tested reason cases
bundles.retirement_trigger: Miss the p95 or recall gate, or fail reason parity by merging distinct causes or producing an export difference.

bundles.track: Zero-Services chelated-kernel Wheel + Blinded Multi-Family Cold-Start Benchmark
bundles.primary_endpoint: Paired cold-start task success, with unsupported-capability and two-tenant isolation canaries, public API boundary, reproducible wheel hash, SBOM, and license gates
bundles.sampling_unit: Clean paired model-family × withheld-fixture × reset-session run across three unrelated families and four fixtures
bundles.retirement_trigger: Miss the paired or preregistered overall/per-family gate, private-import gate, typed unsupported canary, isolation, reproducibility, SBOM, or license gate.

bundles.track: gBench LOFT SciFact Pilot + Disjoint Corpus PM-2 Exact Tango NI
bundles.primary_endpoint: One-shot exact Tango lower confidence bound > -0.0500 on the disjoint zero-write PM-2 contrast, separate from the LOFT SciFact pilot
bundles.sampling_unit: At least 1,000 paired queries from a burn-ledger-clean disjoint corpus
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire if the lower bound ties or misses -0.0500. Record an insufficient finite disjoint pool as underpowered.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Paired derivative-vs-independent withdrawal behavior on BEAM 128K with incremental parity
bundles.named_comparator: Independent withdrawal arm and full recomputation for incremental parity
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire the corresponding claim on a tie or miss of its preregistered endpoint, or failure of incremental parity.

bundles.track: QSCCI Planted Positive Control + k=1 Native Neuron vs. SAE Latent
bundles.primary_endpoint: Planted nuisance-correlated positive control followed by the norm-matched k=1 write-vector contrast on one fresh Qwen3.5-2B REPORT split
bundles.named_comparator: Native neuron vs SAE latent at matched write-vector norm
bundles.sampling_unit: Paired observations on a single fresh REPORT split
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire the probe if the planted control fails or the preregistered contrast ties or misses its threshold.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Holm-adjusted false-alert upper bound <2% across the 1-unit and 4-unit one-way shadow probe, with separate sensitivity and lead time
bundles.named_comparator: Benign family labels on the strict one-way shadow copy across both unit settings
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire the false-alert claim if the adjusted upper bound ties or exceeds 2%, or the shadow design is breached.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Clean 1-hop nDCG@10 merge superiority with positive lower bound and at least 10/12 domains positive, a static 1-hop NI guard, and joint shift and sequential 4-hop superiority
bundles.named_comparator: CSLS vs CalibratedZScore; fixed-CSLS ZeroMu vs UncenteredProcrustes, with CenteredProcrustes, shifted-anchor refit, and direct v1→v5 controls
bundles.sampling_unit: 12 domains with paired queries and 20 frozen 500-anchor draws per domain
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire the affected superiority claim if it ties or misses its preregistered gate, either shift/4-hop component fails, or the bridge misses the static NI floor.

bundles.track: Wild NVD/GHSA/OSV/VEX + SEC 8-K Item 4.02 vs. Independent Postgres 17 Ledger
bundles.primary_endpoint: All-four-cut family disposition and independent-lineage accuracy jointly with concurrent-ingest as_of p95 and per-withdrawal maintenance cost
bundles.named_comparator: DEV-best independent PostgreSQL 17 WITH RECURSIVE ... CYCLE or incremental closure table with equal tuning and production indexes
bundles.sampling_unit: 240 independently adjudicated wild families, 60 per stratum, with four fixed (valid_time, tx_time) cuts per family
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire EK5 proprietary superiority if SQL ties accuracy and sits within 1.25x cost, or if the preregistered superiority rule is missed.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Throughput lower bound >=3.0x at greedy Q4 token equality and within the inclusive 8 GiB cgroup budget
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire if any token differs, the total memory cap is breached, or the throughput lower bound is <3.0x. Restrict mechanical cylinder-order claims to physical ROTA=1.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Time to first usable inference within the 6 GiB cgroup, and zero post-enforcement executions with an exact binomial upper bound
bundles.named_comparator: Physical bandwidth bound and queued/in-flight revocation fence
bundles.sampling_unit: 250 materialized payloads within 1,000 catalog entries and paired queued/in-flight revocation races
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire on a missed preregistered performance gate, memory cap breach, or any post-enforcement execution.

bundles.primary_endpoint: Total block-device write bytes through quiescence for clustered and scattered withdrawals at matched Recall@10 (±0.01) under a 4 GiB cgroup
bundles.named_comparator: Matched-extent on-disk IVF-SQ8 and equally tuned Qdrant on_disk=True
bundles.sampling_unit: Paired clustered and scattered withdrawal workload on the 9.47M corpus
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire if matched recall or memory fails, or write savings tie or miss the preregistered threshold.

bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire if the strict byte ceiling is breached or the preregistered performance/disposition threshold ties or is missed.

bundles.sampling_unit: 20 hash-selected Git repositories × 50 commits, cluster-bootstrapped by repository
bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire if logit equivalence or causal binding fails, or the preregistered cache performance threshold ties or is missed.

bundles.track: Demo D12 /fabric Autonomous DPU/Switch & Multi-Tranche LEO Control Plane

bundles.retirement_trigger: Retire on any oracle deviation, including reserved register 11 or torn epoch reads, or a missed preregistered claim threshold.
